birth_bindings.note: Physical W/h and the complete nonzero-state birth function match across interfaces and modes. Model/optimizer/layout hashes remain branch-specific. Complete worlds match within seed/course; wide and warmup intentionally start with different future-request regimes.

baseline.note: All matched controls are among the fourteen native variants; no imported baseline jobs.

reporting_policy.endpoint_mean: Report only when all three declared seeds succeed at the requested endpoint.
reporting_policy.numerical_failure: Preserve and report the failed seed; no zero score, replacement seed, sensitivity clipping or reset.
reporting_policy.missing_or_execution_failure: Not a scientific numerical failure; repair execution and resume the same source-bound branch.
reporting_policy.forks: Actors, conditions and snapshots do not increase the number of independent trained seeds.

learning: Every 128 real live ticks give one pre-update live gradient plus one equally weighted auxiliary gradient, followed by one Adam update. Auxiliary warmup128 is detached and only its suffix128 is differentiated. Only live RTRL has no fixed time-credit truncation; recorded512 remains a finite window.
numerical_failure: A typed runtime numerical failure becomes an immutable numerical_failure terminal and an evaluation with empty records and endpoint_comparable=false. Execution/resource/code errors remain nonzero and resumable.
limits: The shared-offset derivative stops through realized optimizer/structure changes, actions and the world.
All live h, world, receipts, optimizer, S and history continue across course/withdrawal boundaries.
Actual compute, parameter layouts, real request exposure and graph capacity are reported separately.
Frozen evaluation changes future request draws only, preserving complete inherited state.
